The test image most closely matches Goss's Wilt. The large tan lesion running parallel to veins with irregular wavy margins between tan and green tissue is the hallmark of Goss's Wilt bacterial infection. The Goss's Wilt references (especially 146) show this same elongated streaky tan discoloration pattern.
